verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a set of AI-agent skills where the user hands off whole tasks to the assistant via slash commands: reverse-engineering an app, planning the stack, rebuilding screens, adding backend integrations, writing and running tests, rebranding, and shipping on approval (gh-1, gh-4, gh-5, gh-6, gh-16). However, the AI assistant itself is supplied by the host (Claude Code or a pasted chat), not built into the product (docs-1, docs-2). The product adds the delegated workflows on top of that host. Missing for 10: a product-owned built-in assistant rather than a host-provided one, and independent or hands-on evidence of the delegated workflows actually running end to end.
